title.zh: UK FCA considers bespoke rules and fund exemptions for tokenized gold: FT
title.en: UK FCA considers bespoke rules and fund exemptions for tokenized gold: FT

current_state.zh: The UK FCA is reportedly considering bespoke rules and fund exemptions for tokenized gold as part of a broader push to expand tokenization in wholesale markets, working alongside the Bank of England and HM Treasury.
